title: Water from the Rock at Massah and Meribah
description: At Rephidim the thirsty people complained to Moses because they lacked water. At the Lord's command, Moses struck the rock at Horeb with his staff, and water flowed out. The place was called Massah and Meribah.

versions.title: Water from the Rock
versions.description: Moses strikes the rock with his staff, and water flows out for the thirsty people at Rephidim.
